note: Titles a heir or the house can earn (core/game/game_titles.gd). `kind` personal: the heir's own, ending with them; house: kept by the dynasty. `about` is how it is earned, in plain words, shown even before it is. `when` is one condition: {"stat": key, "gte"/"lte": n}, {"boss": id} (the house has slain it), {"boss_by_heir": id} (this heir did), {"flag": id}, {"trait": id}, {"class": id}, {"race": id}, {"family": true}, or {"all": [...]}, {"any": [...]}, {"not": c}; a list means all. `perk` (only while worn): persuasion is a lower price in shops. A title's name reads after a comma: "Tess Holloway, the Untouched".
